entries.label: Airport — zone de fret du terminal
entries.scene: San Hieronymo AIRPORT cargo area seen in Portable Ops, exactly the terminal service/loading area shown in the references. Preserve green-grey rectangular ribbed shipping containers at one and two tiers, a long pale olive terminal wall behind with repeated small metal utility doors and rectangular door lights, concrete columns and a glimpse of the adjoining tiled terminal through a doorway. Flat dark grey cargo floor and yellow-green daylight/light. The containers sit behind an open clear foreground lane. This covers the cargo/terminal segment only: do not invent a runway, aircraft, control tower, departure signs or modern airport furniture.
